links.comparator_used: Neutral and reference/college-level wording of the same low back pain questions, with no reading-level instruction
links.outcome: Clinical accuracy and completeness of ChatGPT answers, plus Flesch-Kincaid readability
links.effect: Prompt wording influenced accuracy significantly. Over-simplified (4th grade) prompts degraded clinical completeness, while neutral and reference prompts preserved accuracy. No numeric values are given in the abstract. Readability stayed misaligned with health literacy standards whatever the prompt.
links.tradeoff: Simplified prompts produced clinically incomplete answers, and most errors were omissions rather than commissions. Outputs still trended technical, and word count was not a reliable proxy for completeness.
links.quote: Over-simplification of queries (e.g. to a 4th grade level) degrades ChatGPT's ability to return clinically complete responses.
